name: omnilab/emsc
description: Omnilab EMSC: an earthquake of the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre's catalogue by its SeismicPortal id - magnitude and type, place, depth, time, Flinn-Engdahl region, contributing agency - and the earthquakes of a box or around a point over a period as series (count per step, each one's magnitude or depth, or the step's maximum, mean...) or as occurrences, entities with their time and place a page at a time, through the SeismicPortal's FDSN event web service, no key needed.
